name: Macpower CNC Machines: Manufacturing a Strong Growth?
tagline: A CNC machine-tool inflection now confirmed across four straight quarters (Q1 FY27 revenue +56%, EBITDA +95%), funded by a capacity-doubling greenfield plant and premium NEXA mix — tempered by a ~52x multiple and cash conversion running well behind reported PAT
business_overview: Macpower CNC Machines manufactures CNC machine tools, benefiting from India's manufacturing capex and import-substitution cycle. Growth had moderated in FY25 but re-accelerated sharply in the most recent quarters. The company runs an advance-payment order model with real promoter skin-in-the-game, and daily incoming orders (Rs 1-1.5 Cr/day outside of tenders) per a trusted user's AGM notes.
fundamentals_table: Rs 406 Cr (+23% YoY); total bids submitted Rs 1,028 Cr incl. ~Rs 376 Cr defence under evaluation
28-30% revenue growth; PAT +25-30%; hold/gradually improve margin
FY26 CFO ~Rs 14 Cr = ~48% of EBITDA (receivable/inventory build; 182-day cash cycle)
fundamentals_narrative: The deep read turns the baseline's 'inflection not yet proven across multiple quarters' caveat into a confirmed trend: after FY25 grew only 8.7% (machines meant for customers were displayed at IMTEX Bangalore, delaying billing), FY26 revenue rose 27.3% to Rs 333 Cr with PAT +33% to Rs 33.9 Cr, and Q1 FY27 accelerated further to revenue +56% (Rs 95.2 Cr), EBITDA +95% (Rs 15.4 Cr, margin +320 bps to 16.2%) and PAT +110%. EBITDA has grown 95-120% YoY for three consecutive quarters on operating leverage plus a mix shift to the premium NEXA series (~40% of the pending order book). The order book stood at Rs 406 Cr (+23% YoY) at Mar-26 with Rs 1,028 Cr of bids submitted (Rs 652 Cr domestic, Rs 376 Cr defence under evaluation). Management guides 28-30% revenue growth and 25-30% PAT growth for FY27 and delivered inside its FY26 Rs 300-350 Cr guided range. Growth is funded without leverage: a new 30-acre greenfield plant (10,000-machine target capacity; Phase-1 Rs 100 Cr / 2,000 machines) plus 13 acres newly leased near Metoda GIDC for Rs 50 Cr of backward integration (targeted 12-month completion, eligible for Viksit Gujarat 2026 subsidies), all from internal accruals; the company is near debt-free with promoter holding 73.2% (slightly rising, no pledge). The two real cautions: valuation is rich (51.6x P/E, 11.5x P/B) and cash conversion is weak — FY26 CFO was only ~48% of EBITDA on a 182-day cash-conversion cycle, with receivable days set to rise toward 130-135 as the defence mix grows. The separate 108-stock research project independently ranks the same company Tier A.
sentiment_summary: Read the most recent 50 of 142 posts (single batch, no escalation) spanning March 2025 to August 2026. Sentiment has been consistently constructive but not uncritical - the thread includes a substantive, specific caution from a long-time tracker about the company's history of guidance misses, alongside strong AGM commentary and a positive read of a recent insider share-gift as a confidence signal.
community_signal: Tushar_Gupta1 (trusted-roster, 5+ posts, up to 20 loves) provided the most substantive bullish evidence: AGM notes confirming strong order-book growth pace, daily order inflow, and management's explicit confidence that demand will not be a constraint, plus a GST-cut tailwind driving new enquiries. DarshanG (March 2026) raised a specific, fair caution worth weighing: the FY25 guidance miss was partly attributed by management to the biennial IMTEX exhibition diverting production capacity toward demo machines, but DarshanG questioned whether a predictable, years-in-advance calendar event should have been better planned for - implying a real, if modest, track record of guidance unreliability. gauravpersonal (Aug 2026) offered a bullish read of a recent large insider share gift (Rs 80+ Cr) to a promoter-family member's 18-year-old son, arguing no father gifts depreciating shares to a young child, though this is speculative interpretation rather than hard evidence.
bse_notes: Not independently checked this pass. Notice of the 23rd AGM (23 Sept 2026) was posted by a community member seeking someone to ask questions on their behalf - suggests engaged but resource-constrained retail-investor tracking of this name.
bull_case: Inflection now confirmed, not projected: EBITDA +95-120% YoY for three straight quarters; Q1 FY27 revenue +56%, PAT +110%, on top of FY26 revenue +27.3%

Structural margin lever: premium NEXA series ~40% of the order book lifted gross margin from ~32% to ~38%; management aspires to ~25% EBITDA margin (vs 16% now) as premium mix and backward integration build
Order book Rs 406 Cr (+23% YoY) plus Rs 1,028 Cr of bids submitted (incl. Rs 376 Cr defence) give real forward visibility; daily non-tender order inflow of Rs 1-1.5 Cr per AGM notes

Capacity roadmap credibly quadruples volume: 30-acre greenfield (10,000-machine target, Phase-1 Rs 100 Cr) + Rs 50 Cr backward-integration plant on 13 newly-leased acres, funded entirely from internal accruals with promoter holding 73%+ and no pledge
FY26 landed inside the guided Rs 300-350 Cr revenue range and Q1 FY27 is running ahead of the 28-30% FY27 guide — guidance credibility is improving after the FY25 miss
Independently ranked Tier A in the separate 108-stock research project
bear_case: Valuation is rich for a capital-goods manufacturer: 51.6x trailing P/E and 11.5x P/B leave little room for any quarter that misses the 28-30% growth guide

Cash conversion is weak and worsening: FY26 CFO was only ~48% of EBITDA (Rs 14 Cr) on a 182-day cash-conversion cycle; receivable days are guided up toward 130-135 as the defence mix grows — reported PAT is running ahead of cash

Capacity is near its ~2,500-unit ceiling; the new plant has 12-15 month gestation and land finalisation has already slipped once pending government policy — an execution/timing risk to the growth runway
Guidance track record is only mixed: the FY25 miss was on a predictable, years-in-advance exhibition calendar event; one clean year (FY26) is not yet a track record
Technology gap versus German/Japanese machines persists (own Macatrol controller but FANUC-dependent); value market share is only ~4.5% despite strong volume presence
verdict_headline: Confirmed multi-quarter CNC inflection with a funded capacity runway and structural margin mix — the case is stronger than at the sentiment pass, but a ~52x multiple and ~48% cash conversion cap it
verdict_reasoning: The deep read resolves the baseline's central caveat: the re-acceleration is now proven across four consecutive quarters (Q2-Q4 FY26 all 40%+ YoY, Q1 FY27 +56%), with EBITDA compounding faster than revenue on a genuine premium-mix shift, not a one-off

Growth is self-funded — near debt-free, promoter 73%+ and rising, greenfield + backward-integration capex from internal accruals — and FY26 was delivered inside guidance, upgrading management credibility after the FY25 IMTEX miss
Conviction moves up to High: multi-quarter confirmation + structural operating leverage + a credible volume-quadrupling roadmap on a Rs 2,000 Cr small-cap supports 10x-in-2-3-years

Held back from a stronger call by two real offsets the multiple ignores: 51.6x P/E / 11.5x P/B, and cash conversion at ~48% of EBITDA with a 182-day cycle that widens as defence mix grows — watch Q2/Q3 FY27 for both the growth run-rate and a CFO catch-up

FY26 was delivered inside guidance (Rs 333 Cr vs Rs 300-350 Cr guided) — materially improves guidance credibility after the FY25 miss
Two capex programmes now visible: Rs 100 Cr Phase-1 greenfield + Rs 50 Cr backward integration on 13 newly-leased acres, both from internal accruals

Export traction (European dealer/tech-partnership talks) — nothing commercial yet
deep_dive.conviction_update: Medium-High -> High. The filings confirmed the inflection across four quarters, showed FY26 delivered inside guidance, and revealed a fully self-funded capacity roadmap; the rich multiple and ~48% cash conversion keep it from going higher.

market_expectation.implied_growth_cagr: At ~52x trailing P/E, holding value against a ~25x exit for an integrated capital-goods compounder needs ~30%+ EPS CAGR sustained through ~FY29; management's 28-30% growth plus margin creep supports roughly the first two years, so the multiple is pricing near-flawless execution
market_expectation.our_fy27_estimate: Revenue ~Rs 425-435 Cr (+28-30%), EBITDA margin ~16-16.5%, PAT ~Rs 43-45 Cr (+27-32%) - Q1 already tracking ahead
market_expectation.our_fy28_estimate: Revenue ~Rs 540-560 Cr if capacity + backward integration land on schedule; margin drifting to ~17-18% on NEXA mix; PAT ~Rs 57-62 Cr
market_expectation.gap_basis: premium-mix + backward-integration margin lever and defence order optionality are modest upside to a multiple already pricing ~28-30% growth; weak cash conversion is an offsetting risk the multiple ignores
market_expectation.data_caveat: no broker consensus; implied path is a reverse-P/E estimate + screener.in forward figures + VP thread view

catalyst.event: Q2/Q3 FY27 prints confirming the 28-30% full-year run-rate and a CFO catch-up, plus land finalisation / Phase-1 milestone on the 30-acre greenfield plant

value_chain.theme: India manufacturing + defence capex and machine-tool import substitution
value_chain.position: domestic mid-tier CNC machine-tool OEM (turning/machining centres) moving up to the premium NEXA line and defence/aerospace machines
value_chain.bottleneck_node: high-precision / premium machine capability and controller technology (own Macatrol controller but still FANUC-dependent; technology gap vs German/Japanese)
value_chain.note: India CNC demand is strong on manufacturing and defence capex plus import substitution, and BIS standards may curb low-end Chinese imports - but domestic OEMs (Jyoti, Macpower, Lokesh) are all expanding capacity aggressively, so the shortage is being competed away. Macpower's edge is low-cost integrated manufacturing and its own controller; value market share is still only ~4.5% despite strong unit volumes.

drivers: premium NEXA product-mix shift (~40% of order book)
earnings_quality.normalised_note: Reported ~16% EBITDA margin is around mid-cycle, not a spike - historically mid-teens, and management targets a structural climb toward ~20-25% as premium mix and in-house component-making rise. The real asterisk is cash: FY26 CFO was only ~48% of EBITDA on a 182-day cash cycle, so reported PAT overstates cash earnings.

growth_trajectory.last_quarters_note: YoY revenue growth (oldest->newest): FY25 full year +8.7% (IMTEX billing slip) -> Q2 FY26 strong -> Q3 FY26 +42.6% -> Q4 FY26 strong -> Q1 FY27 +56%. EBITDA YoY has run +95-120% for three consecutive quarters.
growth_trajectory.reverse_pe_note: At ~52x trailing the multiple demands ~30%+ EPS CAGR held for 3+ years against a ~25x exit; the recent trend (accelerating revenue, margin +320 bps) supports the near term, but any decel toward the guided 28-30% combined with weak cash conversion would pressure the multiple.

management_quality.capital_allocation: Reinvests internal accruals into capacity (capex Rs ~5 Cr FY21 -> Rs 15 Cr FY26) and now a Rs 100 Cr Phase-1 greenfield plus Rs 50 Cr backward-integration plant; near debt-free; advance-payment order model funds most working capital; no unrelated diversification; modest dividend.
management_quality.capability_ladder_note: Explicit move up the value curve - commodity turning centres -> premium NEXA line -> defence/aerospace machines -> backward integration into spindles/castings/panels and own Macatrol controller; EMO Germany participation and European tech-partnership talks for exports.

four_box.note: Defence/import-substitution tailwind; only ~4.5% value share leaves TAM headroom; controller still FANUC-dependent (weak moat); 52x P/E gap=partially-priced

track_record.note: FY18-FY26 (screener standalone): revenue growth >=10% in 6 of 9 years (dips FY20 COVID -41%, FY23 +6%, FY25 +9%); ROCE >=15% in 7 of 9 (FY20-21 trough at 6-10%). Both cleared FY18, FY19, FY22, FY24, FY26 = 5/9; recent trend strong with ROCE 27-29% FY24-FY26.
